# Wichita Hot Tub Removal

> Professional hot tub, spa, and jacuzzi removal services in Wichita, Kansas and surrounding Sedgwick County communities. Licensed, insured, and eco-friendly disposal. Same-day service available.

## Services

- [Hot Tub Removal](/services/hot-tub-removal/) — Full removal of any size hot tub from decks, patios, and backyards. Includes electrical disconnection, dismantling, and hauling.
- [Spa Removal](/services/spa-removal/) — Above-ground spa and portable spa removal with plumbing disconnect and proper disposal.
- [Jacuzzi Removal](/services/jacuzzi-removal/) — Jacuzzi brand and built-in jacuzzi tub removal with careful dismantling.
- [Pricing](/pricing/) — Transparent pricing from $250–$800. Free estimates with no hidden fees.

## Service Area

Wichita, Derby, Andover, Haysville, Goddard, Maize, Park City, Valley Center, Bel Aire, Kechi, Mulvane, Rose Hill, Clearwater, Cheney, Garden Plain, Sedgwick, Colwich, Mount Hope, Eastborough, McConnell AFB, and all of Sedgwick County.
